name: Jeff Martin
background: Jeff Martin lives in Lander, Fremont County. He lost the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary for House District 54 to incumbent Lloyd Larsen, 1,044 votes (33.0%) to 2,109 (66.7%), according to official primary results already compiled for this site.

Cowboy State Daily reported on Aug. 19, 2026, that this was at least the second time Larsen had defeated Martin, and that Martin had challenged Larsen in the 2024 general election as an Independent. The same article reported that the Fremont County Republican Party endorsed Martin over Larsen in 2026, and that in The Ranger's 2026 voter guide Martin said he would support eliminating residential property taxes.
No public occupation, education, or military record was found in the sources reviewed for this fill.
